planets.name: TOI-431 d
planets.description: TOI-431 d crosses its star every 12.5 days and is 3.3 times as wide as Earth, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-431 d was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-431. Its orbit and size follow Osborn et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
